summary: Fixed post-spawn ChildProcess error handling so only actual exit/close or pre-spawn failure settles terminal observation; bounded cleanup escalates to SIGKILL despite SIGTERM failure and reports signal/process errors or residual process. Browser smoke now asserts clean close and preserves its primary operation failure if teardown also fails. Reproduced the XR-R-T6 failure before repair, passed 9 focused tests and syntax checks, and passed one real HTTP browser smoke with /tmp/chromium. Full runner/seeded oracle remain root-owned and unclaimed; details in reports/R-T6B.md.
